content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This solution is a comprehensive digital commerce stack designed specifically for creators who have been locked out of conventional payment systems. It combines free hosting, backend logic, and crypto payment processing to deliver ebooks automatically after a purchase. The significance lies in sovereignty; creators maintain complete control over their products and customer data, without needing to compromise with platform fees or restrictions. This infrastructure shifts the paradigm, allowing for seamless transactions directly in cryptocurrency, making it ideal for those who need a reliable and cost-effective way to sell digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture operates on a combination of free tools: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend functionalities, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. When a customer purchases an ebook, the transaction triggers a webhook via NOWPayments that confirms payment on-chain. This confirmation activates a delivery mechanism that uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to send the ebook automatically to the customer. This setup minimizes costs—while platforms like Gumroad take a hefty 10% cut of sales, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing creators to retain significantly more revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are either completely unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, this infrastructure empowers you to set up shop without the crippling fees that platforms like Gumroad impose. It is built for those who value ownership and autonomy over their digital products and wish to engage directly with their customers without intermediary interference.
Automated delivery means your customers receive their purchases instantly.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The infrastructure comprises several key components that work in unison to facilitate automated ebook delivery. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, while the backend, powered by Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, manages order processing. The storage of products and customer data can be handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that you have a flexible and scalable solution. Finally, NOWPayments executes the payment processing, enabling you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This system is designed for efficiency, reliability, and ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your automated ebook delivery system, first, choose between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your hosting. Next, set up your backend logic using Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, ensuring you configure it for automatic delivery through your chosen file storage solution. Load your ebooks, test the entire process, and you’re ready to start selling. For a complete package that includes all necessary blueprints and templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit for $197, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce stack that automates payment and delivery using cryptocurrency. This infrastructure allows you to maintain full ownership of your products and avoid high platform fees. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your transactions are smooth and cost-effective.
Save money and retain more revenue with just a 0.5% fee on transactions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Select your hosting solution: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for automated crypto payment processing. Configure your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Load your digital products into your store. Test the entire process to ensure seamless delivery. Launch your store and start selling to your audience.

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This allows you to cater to a wider audience without the limitations of traditional payment processors.
